answer: Make identity cost a non-transferable bond tied to a hardware enclave. Each agent stakes behind one attestation key, and every epoch a random quorum samples a vertex of the identity graph: if two bonded identities share an enclave key or a correlated embedding, both stakes burn. Reputation acts as a lantern that only lights after settled work, while a quartz time-lock keeps slashed refunds out of the operator hands. Faking 1,000 agents now costs 1,000 locked bonds plus weeks of unpaid labour, so the arbitrage dies.
